scope: Geely own-badge and direct Geely subbrands/historic Geely-renamed production families; other holding-company brands excluded.
gaps: Version coverage is partial: EX5 UK3, Starray EM-i UK3, Emgrand Philippines1, Starray Chile2, Coolray Philippines1 and Chile3. Other eras need sourced engine/gearbox tables.
Early MR and Beauty Leopard endpoints conflict across summaries and the2008 manufacturer investor presentation; uncertain dates remain null.
UK Starray EM-i source labels51/84 as kilometres in its table but miles in prose; rangeKm is null. UK0–62mph is not silently relabelled0–100km/h.
Chile Coolray publishes acceleration less than7.6seconds, HP rather than kW, fuel economy in km/L and gross mass; unsupported exact0–100/kW/L100/kerb values remain null.
Geely Emgrand1.5D label is not interpreted as proof of diesel fuel. Exact cc, fuel, cylinder counts and gearboxes remain null where absent in the selected source.
Galaxy TT, Starshine7, M7, Cruiser700, V900 and recent2027-model-year EX5 refresh need confirmed production/badge/date review. Their announcement is not counted as a verified production line here.
Photo search is incomplete, not exhausted. EX2 disguised Proton candidate rejected as wrong badge; CK candidate tight or rear view; Borui tight showroom candidates and EX5 interior rejected.
Photos illustrate production families, not the exact technical variant. Emgrand2021facelift photograph belongs to FE-3 era; MK Cross photograph belongs to hatchback record.
Geometry and Galaxy direct Geely subbrands are included with badge/market notes; separate holding-company marques are excluded.
Rebuild order: night-geely-build, night-geely-versions, night-geely-finish, night-geely-validate. Earlier builders alone overwrite later enrichment.
Haoqing endpoint left null:2006 summary endpoint versus inclusion in2008 OEMproductlineup. MK hatchback start not copied from family2006 introduction.
UK EX5 boot table reverses down/up wording relative to461/1877figures; generation trunkLnull pending unambiguous source.
Rebuild quality step: run night-geely-quality after finish and before validator.
excluded: Emgrand/Englon/Gleagle regionalnames grouped where aGeely productionfamily is evidenced; no holding-company all-brand expansion.

validation.checks: 45unique scoped Geely families/61era records/13selected OEMversions across5eras/10inspected Commonsphotos with exactAPIcredits and1.4-1.7aspect; allunknownsindexed; mass/cyclebasis; no imperial acceleration orHPconversion; no gross-to-kerb substitution; rangeunit conflict preserved.

photoSearches.method: Commons category imageinfo batches50, maxlag5, descriptive research User-Agent; requests paced at least1.1seconds. Exact metadata retained; all selected thumbnails visually inspected.
photoSearches.interruption: One transient Windows candidates.json write error ended the first run; remaining categories resumed in separate target batches. No process killed.

cleanup: All image binaries, source document caches and temporary TypeScript removed; structured Commons metadata and research scripts retained.
next: Review checkpoint and continue missing versions, modern production confirmations and photographs; this is not a completed global trim catalogue.
